title: Verified wipe: destroy-fastest-first ordering, post-wipe readback, boot-time 'wipe verified' assertion, and sweep the duress objects
threat: Wipe atomicity: `trigger_lockout_wipe` discards every result (`let _ =`) and always prints WALLET WIPED; the SE050 sweep does not include the duress OIDs, so after a lockout the decoy half_E stays readable with the (unlimited-attempt) duress PIN; a power cut or SE transport fault mid-wipe leaves a device that claims to be wiped but is not.
proposal: (1) Order the wipe by destruction speed/reliability: SE050 UserID-gated objects first (one SCP03 session), then OPTIGA, then page 124/125/127; arm the page-125 flag before step 1 (already done). (2) Make the verdict honest: after each SE wipe, read back that every target OID is absent/blank (SE050 ReadObject on each DATA_AND_CANARY + DURESS id must return 'no such object'; OPTIGA GetDataObject on F1D1/F1D2/F1D8-F1DA must fail) and only then clear the page-125 flag and show WALLET WIPED; otherwise show 'WIPE INCOMPLETE — reboot to resume' and leave the flag armed. (3) At every boot, when the flag is clear AND page 124 is blank AND the wizard is about to run, re-assert the readback (Ledger's 'wipe verified at startup'); any surviving object re-arms the wipe. (4) Add DURESS_USERID/ENTROPY/VK/BOOTSTRAP_VK (0x7B10_0010..13) to the SE050 sweep lists. (5) Restore and track the untracked 19-test lockout-wipe FI matrix so the WipeFault hooks in MockSecureElement are exercised in CI.
rationale: `cmd_request_unlock.rs:196-209` `let _ = se.factory_reset_admin(); let _ = pin_attempts_reset();` then unconditional WALLET WIPED; `se050/mod.rs:2266-2300` DATA_AND_CANARY_OBJS / AUTH_OBJS_BEST_EFFORT contain no DURESS entries while `se050/mod.rs:66-71` claims the sweep reclaims them; `main.rs:1935-1951` boot resume also `let _`s both calls. Ledger's LSB-003 fix history shows exactly this bug class (3-wrong-PIN wipe cleared OS data but not app data) and the fix shape (wipe verified at startup). Trezor erases the active sector first and re-inits so a torn wipe is never half-observable.

vendor_precedent: Ledger LSB-003 / firmware 1.4: user-zone wipe 'verified at startup'. Trezor storage/norcow.c:284-299 + storage.c:1805-1813 (active sector first, immediate re-init with fresh keys).
risks: Readback costs extra APDUs on a path where the SE may already be flaky; must be bounded and must not be able to block the page-125 flag from ever clearing (resume loop). The 'WIPE INCOMPLETE' screen is itself an oracle that one SE survived; acceptable because the secret is already XOR-split and the flag re-arms the wipe.
